Welcome and thanks for stopping by. I am a student currently enrolled in The University of Arizona's Geographic Information Systems Technology - Master of Science Program. I aspire to use the skills I am learning to work with remote sensing with a focus on climate and environmental related issues. I also have experience working directly with data; cleaning and transforming raw data into useful information and insight. Have a look at my portfolio [here.](Portfolio.qmd)
